metadata.purpose: Forward source values while the predicate is truthy, then complete at its first falsy result, optionally including that value.

cardinality.signature: takeWhile : (T! x Index! -> Boolean!) x Inclusive! -> T* -> T*
conditions: The successful prefix is forwarded; inclusive adds at most the first predicate-failing value, never a value whose predicate throws.
Cω-style markers count values only; errors, cancellation and source lifetime remain separate parts of the contract.

scope.callbacks: One named synchronous predicate invocation per tested input; correlated return/throw is an input. No user function executes in a guard, reaction or generator.
scope.time: No clock, timer or scheduler is created. Sources supply time; equal timestamps retain explicit delivery order. A predicate call/outcome is one synchronous logical reaction.
scope.reentrancy: Non-reentrant reactions, with cancellation between resolved value reactions. Exact source teardown traces use post-setup delivery; synchronous native checks are separate.
exclusions: Arbitrary source/observer/predicate reentry, cancellation during a predicate call, and throwing observers/finalizers.
Index overflow beyond nonnegative safe integers; invalid public callback arguments and compile-time narrowing proofs.
A production predicate interpreter and guarantees that user functions are pure.

initialization.sourceSubscription: One source connection on subscription, even for skip(0); no value is emitted by initialization.

ownership.sharing: No sharing is introduced. Each subscription owns its count or predicate gate even when the producer is hot.
ownership.reset: A fresh subscription starts with fresh bookkeeping. Closed executions accept no more model events.

resources.owner: external binding; invocation generation is execution-local

dispatch.actionSemantics: Compute the next state and ordered actions once. Predicate outcome must resolve before any subsequent external event; actions are descriptions, not executed effects.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between resolved inputs: release the source without a downstream complete notification.
